findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_rxrooster_consultation, search_anesthesia_jobs, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, search_anesthesia_coverage_for_job, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft, resolve_shortlist_location · Private data: get_rxrooster_consultation, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, search_anesthesia_coverage_for_job, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft, save_job_shortlist · Public sink: search_anesthesia_coverage_for_job, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft · Destructive: curate_job_shortlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_rxrooster_consultation, search_anesthesia_jobs, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, search_anesthesia_coverage_for_job, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft, resolve_shortlist_location · Private data: get_rxrooster_consultation, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, search_anesthesia_coverage_for_job, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft, save_job_shortlist · Public sink: search_anesthesia_coverage_for_job, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft · Destructive: curate_job_shortlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
